ceo_directive: Any new candidate must explicitly demonstrate: what old constraint it avoids → what new physical quantity it changes. A previously killed mechanism stays dead unless new evidence overturns the reason it was killed.

cemetery_entry_CE_005.what_was_proposed: Flow-diverting design (localized expansion + 45° deflection at venous outlet, outlet_ratio=1.5, washout_length=3.0mm) to prevent thrombus/fouling accumulation by creating a washout zone where venous blood sweeps the CSF-venous interface.
cemetery_entry_CE_005.why_it_failed: Defeated by El-Shafei retrograde flow on thrombus robustness (5.4x degradation onset vs NEVER up to 10x). Retrograde flow can dislodge thrombus → embolization. V7 is strictly Pareto-dominated by El-Shafei on the robustness dimension that was pre-registered as the differentiator.
cemetery_entry_CE_005.reusable_lesson: Any anti-fouling mechanism that relies on flow direction must be tested against RETROGRADE flow. Retrograde flow is a realistic clinical scenario (cough, Valsalva, venous pressure changes).
cemetery_entry_CE_005.what_to_avoid: Do not propose flow-direction-dependent anti-fouling without testing retrograde flow robustness.

kill_reason_decomposition.root_cause: V7 FDVBZ's anti-fouling mechanism was FLOW-DIRECTION-DEPENDENT. It relied on venous blood flow sweeping the CSF-venous interface in a specific direction (antegrade). When that flow direction was degraded (reversed, reduced, or perturbed), the washout effect failed and thrombus appeared.
kill_reason_decomposition.specific_failure_mode: Thrombus onset at 5.4× degradation of blood_entry_prob (the key parameter). El-Shafei retrograde flow NEVER produced thrombus up to 10× degradation.
kill_reason_decomposition.pareto_domination: V7 FDVBZ is strictly worse than El-Shafei on the robustness dimension. El-Shafei's mechanism (short residence time) is robust to flow direction changes; V7's mechanism (washout zone geometry) is not.
what_would_overturn_the_kill: OPTION A: New evidence that El-Shafei's robustness was miscomputed (e.g., El-Shafei also fails at a different degradation parameter not tested in V18).
OPTION B: A flow-direction mechanism that beats El-Shafei on a DIFFERENT decisive dimension (not robustness) — e.g., drainage rate, OSI, or a dimension El-Shafei fails on.
OPTION C: A non-flow-direction mechanism that achieves anti-fouling without any flow-direction dependency.
kill_reason_decomposition.anti_rescue_rule: V7 FDVBZ stays dead. The 5.4× vs NEVER Pareto domination by El-Shafei is the kill reason. To overturn it requires NEW EVIDENCE (Option A or B), not a re-argument of the old evidence. Option C is a DIFFERENT mechanism, not a rescue of V7.

class_1_prevention.description: Surface chemistry / coating / hydrogel / zwitterionic / PEG / heparin-bonded / titanium oxide / nanostructured surface that prevents protein adsorption, platelet adhesion, and biofilm formation at the material level.
class_1_prevention.old_constraint_avoided: Flow-direction dependency. V7 FDVBZ relied on venous blood flow to sweep the interface. Surface chemistry acts on the SURFACE ITSELF, independent of flow direction.
class_1_prevention.new_physical_quantity_changed: Surface free energy / protein adsorption rate constant / platelet adhesion coefficient / biofilm nucleation rate at the material-blood and material-CSF interfaces. NOT flow topology.
class_1_prevention.ce_005_blast_radius: NONE — this mechanism class is NOT in CE-005's failure mode. CE-005 killed a FLOW mechanism, not a SURFACE mechanism.
class_1_prevention.retrograde_flow_test_required: NO — the mechanism does not depend on flow direction. (However, the mechanism should still be tested under retrograde flow to confirm it does not CREATE a new retrograde-flow-dependent failure mode — e.g., if a coating delaminates under reverse shear.)
class_1_prevention.overlap_with_R6: NONE — R6 is a bypass mechanism for obstruction, not a prevention mechanism.
class_1_prevention.verdict: IN_SCOPE — candidates in this class are epistemically permitted. Must still pass Article XX problem-existence gate (yellow), patent gate, and strongest-alternative attack.

class_2_bypass.description: An alternate drainage pathway that activates when the primary lumen obstructs. Passive (pressure-driven) or active (sensor-triggered).
class_2_bypass.old_constraint_avoided: Reliance on a single drainage pathway. V7 FDVBZ had one washout zone; if it failed, drainage failed.
class_2_bypass.new_physical_quantity_changed: Redundancy / number of independent drainage pathways / failover threshold.
class_2_bypass.ce_005_blast_radius: PARTIAL — depends on implementation. If the bypass is flow-direction-dependent (like V7), it inherits CE-005's failure mode. If it's PASSIVE (pressure-driven, no flow-direction dependency), it avoids CE-005.
class_2_bypass.retrograde_flow_test_required: YES — even a passive bypass must be tested under retrograde flow to confirm it does not create retrograde embolization (the exact failure mode that killed V7).
class_2_bypass.critical_overlap_concern: HIGH OVERLAP WITH R6. R6 is a passive bypass lumen for obstruction (the obstruction triggers bypass activation via pressure differential). If T5's 'bypass' candidate is just R6 applied to fouling, it is NOT a new invention — it is R6. T5 bypass must be DIFFERENT from R6: either (a) a different bypass trigger (fouling-specific, not pressure), (b) a different bypass target (not the venous sinus), or (c) a different physical implementation (not a slit valve).
class_2_bypass.verdict: IN_SCOPE_WITH_CONSTRAINT — candidates must (a) be passive (not flow-direction-dependent), (b) be distinct from R6, and (c) pass retrograde-flow robustness testing. The R6 overlap concern is a major filter.

class_3_self_clearing.description: The device actively clears itself of fouling through mechanical action (e.g., vibration, shape-memory actuation, reversible expansion) or hydrodynamic action (e.g., reverse flush, pulsatile flow).
class_3_self_clearing.old_constraint_avoided: Static surface that accumulates fouling without remediation.
class_3_self_clearing.new_physical_quantity_changed: Mechanical cleaning action / shear stress at the surface / fouling removal rate.
class_3_self_clearing.ce_005_blast_radius: HIGH — if self-clearing relies on flow direction (e.g., reverse flush), it directly inherits CE-005's retrograde-flow failure mode. A reverse flush IS retrograde flow — the exact mechanism that killed V7.
class_3_self_clearing.retrograde_flow_test_required: MANDATORY — and likely to fail, given CE-005's lesson. Any flow-direction-based clearing mechanism must be tested against the EXACT failure mode that killed #5.
class_3_self_clearing.cross_reference_CE_010: CE-010 (T6 flow-reversal clearing, R3) was ALSO killed for a related reason: 'Retrograde flow in R3 causes debris mobilization from the shunt into the SAS → embolization to the BRAIN (neural direction). This is WORSE than #5 because the brain is more sensitive to particulate matter than the lungs.' So TWO cemetery entries (CE-005 and CE-010) both kill flow-reversal/retrograde clearing mechanisms.
class_3_self_clearing.verdict: HIGH_RISK — flow-direction-based self-clearing is doubly-killed (CE-005 + CE-010). Only non-flow self-clearing (e.g., mechanical vibration, thermal, ultrasonic) is in scope, and those introduce their own failure modes (fatigue, power, heating).

class_4_surface_state_control.description: Active control of the surface state to prevent fouling — e.g., electrical surface potential, thermal pulse, pH modulation, electrochemical cleaning. The surface is actively maintained in an anti-fouling state.
class_4_surface_state_control.old_constraint_avoided: Passive surface properties. V7 FDVBZ was passive geometry. Surface-state control is ACTIVE — it modulates the surface in real-time.
class_4_surface_state_control.new_physical_quantity_changed: Surface charge / surface potential / temperature / pH / electrochemical state at the interface.
class_4_surface_state_control.ce_005_blast_radius: NONE — this is an active mechanism, not a flow mechanism. CE-005 killed a passive flow mechanism.
class_4_surface_state_control.retrograde_flow_test_required: NO for the anti-fouling mechanism itself. YES for confirming the active mechanism does not CREATE a flow-direction-dependent failure mode (e.g., if a thermal pulse creates convection that depends on flow direction).
new_failure_modes_introduced: Power source (battery) — limited lifetime, requires replacement
Electrochemical corrosion — active surface may degrade faster
Thermal damage — heating could injure surrounding tissue
MRI compatibility — active electrical components may be MRI-unsafe
class_4_surface_state_control.verdict: IN_SCOPE — candidates must demonstrate that the active control does not introduce failure modes worse than the fouling it prevents (Article XX Question 5). Power and MRI compatibility are major filters.

class_5_sacrificial_interface_separation.description: A sacrificial layer that fouls and is then shed/renewed, OR a physical interface that separates the fouling-prone surface from the critical drainage surface. E.g., a replaceable filter, a biodegradable coating, a double-lumen with a fouling-accepting outer layer.
class_5_sacrificial_interface_separation.old_constraint_avoided: Permanent surface that must never foul. The sacrificial approach ACCEPTS that fouling will occur and manages it by renewal or separation.
class_5_sacrificial_interface_separation.new_physical_quantity_changed: Sacrificial layer thickness / renewal rate / interface separation distance.
class_5_sacrificial_interface_separation.ce_005_blast_radius: NONE — this is a material/maintenance mechanism, not a flow mechanism.
class_5_sacrificial_interface_separation.retrograde_flow_test_required: NO for the mechanism itself. YES for confirming that shed material does not embolize under retrograde flow (the CE-005 failure mode).
new_failure_modes_introduced: Shed material embolization — if the sacrificial layer sheds, where does it go?
Renewal mechanism complexity — how is the sacrificial layer renewed in an implant?
Lifetime limitation — sacrificial layer has finite capacity
class_5_sacrificial_interface_separation.verdict: IN_SCOPE — candidates must demonstrate that shed material does not embolize (CE-005 lesson) and that the renewal/replacement mechanism is clinically feasible.

classes_IN_SCOPE_WITH_CONSTRAINT: class_2_bypass (must be passive + distinct from R6 + retrograde-flow-tested)
cemetery_attack_summary.V7_FDVBZ_status: DEAD — stays dead per anti-rescue rule. Kill reason: Pareto-dominated by El-Shafei on robustness margin. To overturn requires new evidence (Option A/B), not re-argument.
cemetery_attack_summary.next_step: Step 2 (four-search discovery) — search across the IN-SCOPE and IN-SCOPE-WITH-CONSTRAINT classes. Let evidence decide the actual candidate set. Do NOT force candidates into classes that are HIGH_RISK or out of scope.
